Back Track.name: Back Track
Back Track.summary: Domingoaniax and his army of mutants and robot soldiers have taken control of the secret moon base. For months these aliens have been abducting humans and assimilating them into an army of droids that can be used to overwhelm Earth. As our last hope, you must help Jim Track infiltrate the moon base and succeed where many others before him have failed. Destroy every alien or assimilated human you encounter, port back as many unassimilated humans from the pods as possible, and then trigger the self-destruct sequence to terminate the moon base and the remaining aliens.

Derby Stallion Advance.name: Derby Stallion Advance
Derby Stallion Advance.summary: Derby Stallion Advance is a Sports game, developed by ParityBit and published by Enterbrain, which was released in Japan in 2002.

Hello Kitty - Happy Party Pals.name: Hello Kitty: Happy Party Pals
Hello Kitty - Happy Party Pals.summary: Hello Kitty is throwing a party and she needs your help! Explore her world to pick out the perfect outfit, party music and more. It's up to you and Hello Kitty to plan the perfect party!

TOCA World Touring Cars.name: TOCA World Touring Cars
TOCA World Touring Cars.summary: TOCA World Touring Cars (Called Jarrett & Labonte Stock Car Racing in the USA and WTC: World Touring Car Championship in Japan) is a racing video game developed and published by Codemasters, and released for Game Boy Advance only in Europe in 2003. It is part of the TOCA Touring Car series.
